title: Wrong mouse pointer over widget scrollbar
line: Hovering a Sticky Note's scroll bar now shows the normal pointer instead of a text cursor.
explanation: The Sticky Note sets the text (I-beam) cursor with a MouseArea that fills the whole drop area around the scroll view. That area includes the vertical and horizontal scroll bars, so the scroll bar showed a text cursor too. The change keeps that MouseArea inside the scroll view's padding, which Plasma's ScrollView sets to the scroll bar's width only while a scroll bar is shown, so text keeps the I-beam and the scroll bar gets the normal pointer.

commits.message:
applets/notes: Show the normal pointer over the scroll bar

The area that shows the text cursor covered the whole scroll view,
scroll bar included, so hovering the scroll bar showed a text cursor.
Keep it inside the scroll view's padding.

BUG: 422296

patches.diff:
From 4a7fc8b4d23853d4b835fe8912ddf22ff6243fd2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:58:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notes: Show the normal pointer over the scroll bar

The area that shows the text cursor covered the whole scroll view,
scroll bar included, so hovering the scroll bar showed a text cursor.
Keep it inside the scroll view's padding.

BUG: 422296
---
 applets/notes/qml/main.qml | 4 ++++
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/notes/qml/main.qml b/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
index 63a6409ba..d97d48e12 100644
--- a/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
@@ -477,6 +477,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
                 MouseArea {
                     anchors.fill: parent
+                    // Only over the text, not over the scroll bars
+                    anchors.leftMargin: scrollview.leftPadding
+                    anchors.rightMargin: scrollview.rightPadding
+                    anchors.bottomMargin: scrollview.bottomPadding
                     cursorShape: mainTextArea.hoveredLink ? Qt.PointingHandCursor : Qt.IBeamCursor
                     acceptedButtons: Qt.NoButton
                 }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: text cursor on the highlighted scroll bar
After: normal pointer on the scroll bar
Before: the pointer moves from the text onto the scroll bar and stays a text cursor
After: the same movement switches to the normal pointer on the scroll bar

review.text: Clean QML fix in the Sticky Note applet that insets the I-beam cursor MouseArea by scrollview's left, right, and bottom padding so the scroll bar keeps the normal arrow pointer. Using both leftPadding and rightPadding properly accounts for RTL as well as LTR layouts and avoids any binding loop, while keeping the full I-beam area when no scroll bar is visible. The screenshots, videos, and Wayland cursor-shape verification thoroughly prove the fix.

reviews.text: Clean QML fix in the Sticky Note applet that insets the I-beam cursor MouseArea by scrollview's left, right, and bottom padding so the scroll bar keeps the normal arrow pointer. Using both leftPadding and rightPadding properly accounts for RTL as well as LTR layouts and avoids any binding loop, while keeping the full I-beam area when no scroll bar is visible. The screenshots, videos, and Wayland cursor-shape verification thoroughly prove the fix.

The I-beam MouseArea filled the whole DropArea, which is anchored to the ScrollView, so it covered the scroll bars; inset it by the ScrollView's left/right/bottom padding, which libplasma's PC3 ScrollView sets to the scroll bar size only when a bar is visible (and on the left in RTL). Small, correct layer, no behavior change for clicks or drops since the MouseArea accepts no buttons. Screenshots and the Wayland set_shape log clearly show I-beam before and arrow after on the scroll bar.
